messages:
tanya-sales: LatticeWorks POC is blocked. Their CTO requested a written 99.9% regional uptime commitment for Dedicated plus a hard pricing cap if usage exceeds 2B tokens/month. Security also raised BYO KMS questions. We need an internal plan before the exec sync tomorrow.

sam-se: Got it. Clarify: are they asking for reserved GPUs or just a contractual SLA on Dedicated?

tanya-sales: Reserved seed capacity + contractual SLA. CTO expects options by EOD tomorrow.

alejandra-cto: I can draft SLA language. Need baseline vs burst throughput numbers and fallback model latency targets.

ravi-infra: For sizing we need their 95th pct tokens/sec. Any POC traces?

cora-sales-lead: Shared traces earlier: avg QPS ~350, short peaks ~1.2k. Link: https://redwood.internal/poctraces/LATT-20250412

matt-sre: 99.9% in-region is achievable with multi-AZ + warm standby. If they want financial remedies we need a runbook and a canary fallback to a quantized variant. I'll draft runbook notes.

sam-se: Pricing cap suggestion: committed baseline (reserved GPU pool) + capped overage for first 90 days. I'll sketch numbers.

pricing-bot: Template: "Committed X GPUs / Y tokens -> $Z/mo. Overage capped at 25% of committed cost for first 90 days." See /pricing/templates/enterprise-cap-floor.md

alejandra-cto: On KMS BYO: we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated but need their key rotation policy and attestation level. Legal will require enrollment docs.

tanya-sales: Action items: @alejandra-cto SLA draft (12h), @sam-se pricing cap draft (8h), @ravi-infra KMS one-pager (EOD), @matt-sre runbook + peering rec (EOD). I will consolidate and loop in Finance and Legal. Ping me if you need me to escalate to execs.

ops-bot: Added playbook: /ops/playbooks/dedicated-failover.md (timestamp 1759123600)

alejandra-cto: SLA draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/lattice-sla-v1.md

sam-se: Pricing draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/lattice-pricing-cap-v1.md

ravi-infra: KMS one-pager uploaded: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-byowhitepaper.pdf - note: customer key policy required for enrollment.

matt-sre: Runbook slides ready for CTO sync at 15:00.

tanya-sales: Thanks team. I'll update after the exec sync. :thumbsup:
